name: Agent skills loaded in the product's own format, not the open SKILL.md one

find.note: A folder of agent skills on disk
A setting for where skills live

why: A product whose agents take skills in its own manifest can't load the skills people publish in the open SKILL.md format. It fits only if the product really has a skills feature users add to and the format is its own: a repo with SKILL.md support elsewhere is a false alarm, which the line alone can't show, so the judge must read the README and the code. Seen on 39 real repos: 3 repos fire, and only one of them is a real hit, so this detector is under the 85% bar on its own and leans on the judge. A person should decide whether it stays live.
